'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[India in the 2026 Iran war]]
*****[[Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas|Indian petroleum minister]] [[Hardeep Singh Puri]] says that 12 [[Liquefied petroleum gas|LPG]] [[Gas carrier|vessels]] from [[India]] have successfully transited through the [[Strait of Hormuz]] without paying tolls. [https://www.uniindia.com/~/india-moved-over-12-lpg-vessels-out-of-strait-of-hormuz-without-paying-tolls-hardeep-singh-puri/Business%20Economy/news/3892566.html (''United News of India'')]
****[[Iran–Oman relations]]
*****[[Iran]] holds its first joint committee meeting with [[Oman]] in [[Muscat]] to discuss future management of the Strait of Hormuz following [[Islamabad Memorandum|a preliminary agreement]] with the [[United States]] to end the war. [[Federal government of the United States|U.S. officials]] say shipping can resume freely. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/middle-east/iran-says-it-has-met-oman-on-managing-hormuz (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
**[[2026 Lebanon war]]
***[[2026 Israel–Lebanon ceasefire]]
****The [[National News Agency]] reports that over 40,000 [[Lebanese displacement during the Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|displaced people]] have returned to [[Lebanon]] since the [[ceasefire]]. [https://today.lorientlejour.com/article/1539716/war-on-lebanon-40-of-forcibly-displaced-return-to-home-regions-announces-haneen-sayed.html (''L'Orient Today'')]
**[[Assassination and terrorism in Iran]], [[Iran internal crisis (2025–present)|Iran internal crisis]]
***Gunmen kill two members of Iran's [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps|Revolutionary Guards]] and injure two others outside a residence in [[Paveh]], [[Kermanshah province]]. [[Human rights in the Kurdistan Region|Kurdish rights]] group [[Hengaw]] says an armed group called Xori Hiwa claims responsibility. [https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/two-revolutionary-guards-members-killed-by-gunmen-western-iran-2026-06-30/ (Reuters)]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli forces]] hit a tent in central [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]], killing three [[Palestinians]], including an 8-year old boy. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-gaza-airstrike-hamas-civilians-156a754e51d1647add376554bd518f2f (AP)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[War crimes during the Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|War crimes during the Sudanese civil war]]
***[[Foreign involvement in the Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Foreign involvement in the Sudanese civil war]]
****Human rights organizations led by the [[Raoul Wallenberg Centre for Human Rights]] reportedly file a complaint with the [[International Criminal Court]] against officials from [[Libya]] and the [[United Arab Emirates]] for their role in atrocities committed in the [[civil war]], most [[Darfur genocide (2023–present)|notably]] the [[Darfur]] region. [https://libyaobserver.ly/news/libya-and-uae-officials-accused-involvement-sudan-war-crimes (''Libya Observer'')] [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/senior-uae-and-regional-officials-referred-icc-alleged-role-darfur-atrocities (''Middle East Eye'')]
**[[2026 Blue Nile campaign]]
***The [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] announces that they have retaken the towns of Sirkum and Mugaja in [[Sudan]]'s [[Blue Nile State]]. [https://www.sudanspost.com/sudanese-military-retakes-sirkum-and-mugaja-in-blue-nile/ (''Sudans Post'')]
**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***The [[Darfur Joint Protection Force|joint forces]] allied with the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] recapture the [[West Darfur]] town of [[Kulbus, Sudan|Kulbus]], two years after it was captured by the [[paramilitary]] group [[Rapid Support Forces]] in October 2024. [https://sudantribune.com/article/315676 (''Sudan Tribune'')]
**The [[Armed Conflict Location and Event Data]] publishes an article accusing the [[Rapid Support Forces]] of killing more civilians in Sudan, including in 2025, than other rebel groups. [https://sudanhorizon.com/international-monitor-rsf-accounted-for-11-of-global-civilian-killings-by-armed-groups/ (''Sudan Horizon'')]
**The [[Yale University|Yale]] [[Yale School of Public Health|School of Public Health]]’s Humanitarian Research Lab reports that the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) 5th Infantry Division has established checkpoints, defensive berms, and trenches in [[El-Obeid]], [[North Kordofan]]. [https://ysph.yale.edu/download-file/76d1775e-de0c-4861-afae-7aa92c4c0228/ (HRL)] [https://sudantribune.com/article/315720 (''Sudan Tribune'')]
*[[2026 Afghanistan–Pakistan war]]
**[[Ministry of Information & Broadcasting (Pakistan)|Pakistani information minister]] [[Attaullah Tarar]] says that [[Pakistan]] has carried out [[airstrike]]s in [[Afghanistan]] targeting alleged [[Jamaat-ul-Ahrar]] headquarters, killing 25 militants in border regions and the eastern [[Provinces of Afghanistan|provinces]] of [[Paktia Province|Paktia]], [[Paktika Province|Paktika]], and [[Kunar Province|Kunar]]. [https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/world/2026/06/29/pakistan-says-carried-out-new-strikes-in-afghanistan-targeting-militants (AFP via ''Free Malaysia Today'')]
**[[Government of Afghanistan|Afghan officials]] say that over 36 civilians have been killed in overnight strikes by Pakistan, and more than 160 have been injured. [https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-pakistan-airstrikes-militants-eaf84d1a19cd5e5df750511c310ae906 (AP)]
**[[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Afghanistan)|Afghan foreign minister]] [[Amir Khan Muttaqi]] summons the [[chargé d'affaires]] at the [[Embassy of Pakistan, Kabul|Pakistani embassy]] in [[Kabul]] over the airstrikes. [https://8am.media/eng/taliban-summon-pakistan-envoy-airstrikes/ (''Hasht-e Subh'')] [https://www.indiatoday.in/amp/world/story/afghanistan-summons-pakistan-envoy-after-deadly-airstrikes-in-kunar-paktia-paktika-2936551-2026-06-29 (''India Today'')]
*Aftermath of the [[South Sudanese Civil War]]
**Five [[Humanitarian aid|aid workers]] are killed and four more injured in an [[ambush]] against a [[convoy]] by unknown gunmen in [[Duk County]], [[Jonglei State]], [[South Sudan]]. Several civilians are also killed and wounded. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/30/five-humanitarian-workers-killed-in-convoy-ambush-in-south-sudan (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Kidnapping in Nigeria]]
**Gunmen abduct 36 students and a staff member from a [[secondary school]] in Lassa, [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]], while authorities say eight others have been rescued. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-37-still-captivity-after-northeast-nigeria-school-attack-official-says-2026-06-30/ (Reuters)]

**[[2025–2026 China–Japan diplomatic crisis]]
***[[China]] adds 20 [[Japan]]ese organizations to a [[Dual-use technology|dual-use]] [[Chinese government sanctions|export blacklist]] and places 20 others on a watchlist, citing concerns over [[Japan Self-Defense Forces|Japan's military]] capabilities amid worsening relations between China and Japan. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/germany-shooting-stade-youth-center/ (CBS News)] [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-at-least-5-killed-in-shooting-in-stade/a-77754951 (DW)]
